sources.text: NSTAR Lab The NSTAR Lab conducts clinical trials and experimental studies that integrate novel treatment development and neuroimaging biomarkers. The goal of our work is to translate discoveries from this integrated approach into improved mental health treatment for individuals with PTSD, anxiety, and depression . Learn more about the lab or get in contact with us Our Lab Learn more about the staff here at NSTAR Lab Click Here Contact Us Contact us to participate in one of our studies, become one of our student RAs, or one of our Graduate Students. Click Here Interested in Participating in Research? We are currently running a study about repetitive negative thinking. Click the button below to learn more about the study and how to join. sources.title: contact the bomyea lab
sources.text: Contact Us If you are having an emergency, please call 911 If you have questions about our lab or would like more information, please contact us at (858) 822-1470 UCSDanxietylab@health.ucsd.edu If you are interested in becoming one of our research assistants, please follow the instructions outlined on our "prospective student research assistants" page. If you are interested in participating in one of our research studies, the best way to contact us is via email. Please include your name, the study your are interested in, your phone number, and a few good times to give you a call.
